Text: Add sex-specific birth weight to `ph_ch_anthro` (see [Sex-Specific Birthweight for GA](https://docs.hbcdstudy.org/latest/instruments/physhealth/growth/#warning)).

A future release will include reliability codes integrated into the primary coding dataset. Until then, users must perform this integration manually: see the ERICA Data Warning for instructions. Instructions include cleaning the current files to exclude n=44 participants with incorrect code values (data entry/form errors), capping `b_raw` values at 3.0 (n=3 participants), and removing the “Locomotor Ability” field (`mh_cg_erica_3_9m_locomotor_ability`), which has errors, also to be corrected in the next release.

Family-level (i.e., non-child-specific) instrument fields are currently populated only for the Main Child, not sibling records (e.g., HBCD Multiple Birth – Sibling). Until resolved, users should obtain family-level values for sibling participants from the corresponding Main Child record. See the participant ID mapping in the [HBCD Private Release Notes](https://hbcd-docs-private.lassoinformatics.com/#download).
N=4 V06 participants with <3 item responses are incorrectly scored as `0`; set values to null prior to analysis.
Pro-rated scoring for `mh_cg_mapdb__tod` not yet implemented; N=16 participants missing scores.
N=12 V03 participants with <3 item responses are incorrectly scored as `0` in `mh_cg_pms__cc__inf`; set values to null prior to analysis.
Addition Cook's distance values computed for fMRI.
N=4 participants with no item responses are incorrectly scored as `0`; set values to null prior to analysis.

A small subset of participants have implausible `gestational_age` (V01 only) values for one or more instrument. Until corrected, review GA distribution to exclude outliers from analysis (should be positive and generally < 45 weeks).
Adjusted age contains N=303 "unknown missing" values that are also missing 'Date of Administration'.
N=14 participants in `sed_basic_demographics` have a Maternal Age at V01 of 0; exclude these values from analyses until corrected.
Text inappropriately located in score fields where score is missing to be moved to corresponding 'notes' field (impacts ecPROMIS-PAGS; MAPS-TL; SPM-2).
PNR data were incorrectly reported using TLFB versions 1/2 and will be updated to [version 3 specific to PNR](https://docs.hbcdstudy.org/latest/instruments/pregexp/su/tlfb/#v3)
Participants missing all item responses are incorrectly scored as `0`; set values to null prior to analysis.
The data dictionary element `type_data` for `average_bmi` will be corrected to `double` (currently=`character`).
Nail type is `4` (Unknown) in the main results table (`*_nails_results`) and should be obtained from the specimen table (`*_nails_type`).

ICD codes for the `pex_bm_health*` tables are inconsistently provided, sometimes missing corresponding names/labels. For example, medication names are present for the _Health V1- Medications_, while the _Health V2- Pregnancy_ instrument only has medication codes without corresponding labels. Until resolved, users can use external packages to merge ICD labels if needed: [Stata](https://www.stata.com/features/overview/icd/), [SAS](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/toolssoftware/ccsr/dxccsr.jsp), [R](https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/icd/versions/3.3)
Inclusion of Blood Spot Card Results data from USDTL.
Add all age and `date_taken` fields (currently excluded due to use of coding rather than visit dates).
Inconsistent scoring: (1) item responses present, but score is null (N=1); (2) all items null, but score is `0` (N≥3).

Growth (`ph_ch_anthro`) filter ranges will be updated to be visit-specific, as current ranges allow biologically implausible values (see [Range Checks](https://docs.hbcdstudy.org/latest/instruments/physhealth/growth/#warning)).
Add household roster fields capturing the sex of listed individuals (adult & child tables).

Relationship status was inappropriately collected at V02/V03 for all cohorts and should have been restricted to cases where there was a change in caregiver (i.e. only Alternative Caregiver cohorts should have this field populated). Data for non-ACG cohorts to be excluded.
Remove invalid scores of `-9999`; until resolved, users should remove this participant data prior to analysis.
Chronological and adjusted age fall outside of 3-9 months in N=74 V03 sessions (site entry errors); exclude age values prior to analysis.
Additional QC fields added to the scans TSV files related to line artifacts in fmaps (`line2_*`)
Roster was inappropriately collected at V02/V03 for all cohorts and should have been restricted to V02 PNRs and alternate caregiver cohorts; to be excluded.
Addition of Geocoded Linkage from Home and Work Addresses
Addition of the MAPS-EASI- Toddler
Addition of TIC Questionnaire table
Percentiles incorrectly converted for N=36 cases, resulting in values >100 ('Adjusted Percentile' incorrectly parsed from 'Total Produced' instead of 'Total Produced Percentile-sex (adjusted)')
Harmonize participant status and withdrawal fields

The Coping Skills, Domestic, and Written subscales are not administered at V05 because children are too young. However, for some participants, the missing reason is incorrectly coded as "Logic skipped" or "Unknown" in the shadow matrix. In addition, the age of one child is outside of the valid bounds for V05.

The `screen_race_multi__*` variables are almost entirely coded as '0' and should not be used for analysis. Users interested in race and ethnicity information should instead use the corresponding derived ACS race and ethnicity variable. Values will be corrected in a future release.

Metadata field values were corrected for several instruments, but are not yet corrected in the JSON files. IN PARTICULAR, PLEASE CHECK `type_data` CAREFULLY as an incorrect data type may impact analyses. Impacted instruments include: **APA 1/2**, **Bayley-4**, and **EEG Form-2**. See details in [Release Notes](../release-notes/#data-warning).

A `FamilyID` field will be added to instruments to identify sibling relationships. Until then, sibling ID mapping (Main Child vs Sibling) is provided in the [HBCD Private Release Notes](https://hbcd-docs-private.lassoinformatics.com/#download).
Tabulated data for QSIRecon (participant data combined across derivative files into single tidy table) will be provided in a future release.

Addition of individual functional network maps (generated with template matching) and [ModelArray](https://modelarrayio.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) outputs for XCP-D for efficient voxel-wise statistical modeling.

Scanner metadata, currently available within the raw BIDS Scans TSV files, will be additionally provided within the tabulated data for ease of access (see [Participant Derived](#infobbox) domain info on this page).
Add more fields to `ph_ch_vs` (current release only includes completion status and overall screening results).
The currently included Sequence field is blank across all instruments and will be removed.
Total non-parental hours/week (`ncl_ch_mlds_arr_hr_wk`) includes implausible values due to data entry errors. Exclude values >168 hours from analysis.

The `run-{X}` field may not reflect chronological acquisition order. While this affects both **raw BIDS and derivatives**, data remain internally consistent (i.e. run IDs match between raw and processed datasets).
Add Infant Sleep (IS) sub-scale score to `ph_cg_bisq`.
The field for the date when PNV was stopped (`pex_bm_healthv2_preg__exp__pnv_007__01`) is blank, despite participants having reported stopping.
Note that items about aspirin use (`pex_bm_healthv2_preg__exp__pnv_{011|012}`) are largely blank.
The 'instruction' data dictionary element is currently blank.
Addition of the Early Child Care and Education

`LargeDelta` and `SmallDelta` in the sidecars currently are set to vendor-specific values (which aren't always correct because the models have their own values) and will be updated to reflect accurate values.
Raw MR data QC metrics provided in the raw BIDS SCANS TSV files will be combined into a single table across participants/sessions.
Addition of raw BIDS data for GABI (infant heart rate).
HBCD-MADE derivatives processed through updated version v1.7.0
Add source DICOMs for all imaging modalities.
Addition of the MacArthur-Bates CDI-2 Language
Addition of V06
Addition of the Child Nutrition Questionnaire.
Addition of instrument: Deferred Imitation Task: Gong and Berry-Go-Round
Addition of V6 Adult and V6 Child Demographics
Addition of the Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers
Addition of the PEDsQL
Addition of the Incarceration Questionnaire
